name: Ursuline College
academic_ranking: Private Catholic liberal arts college founded by the Ursuline Sisters; ranked the #1 most affordable private liberal arts college in Ohio (U.S. Dept. of Education College Scorecard) for three consecutive years and #1 college in Ohio for student upward mobility. Known for the Breen School of Nursing (reports 100% nursing grad employment post-licensure), healthcare programs, and a nationally noted Counseling & Art Therapy master's program.
financial_aid: 2026-2027 full-time undergraduate tuition is $40,440 (12-18 credits/semester); part-time rate $1,348/credit. Ursuline is recognized as the most affordable private liberal arts college in Ohio for three consecutive years. Detailed scholarship award amounts not published on the tuition page; net price calculator and scholarship pages referenced (ursuline.edu/cost-aid).
facilities_notes: Softball program page (ursulinearrows.com/sports/softball) does not detail a dedicated softball facility; specific field/facility information not publicly listed on the athletics site as of research date.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II member competing in the Great Midwest Athletic Conference (G-MAC). Softball roster of ~20 for the 2026 season. Small women's-focused Catholic institution athletics program (Arrows).
notes: Coaching staff verified against ursulinearrows.com softball coaches page and athletics staff directory (checked 2026-07). NOTE: automated fetches of the coaches page reported coach emails on a '@gannon.edu' domain, which is inconsistent with Ursuline College (gannon.edu belongs to a different institution, Gannon University); these could not be verified as genuinely published Ursuline emails, so emails were left blank rather than risk propagating incorrect data. Conference confirmed as G-MAC. Roster size (20) from softball roster page.
